blocks.content:
The President can be removed for violation of the Constitution.
Impeachment Process:
• Initiated in either House of Parliament
• Requires special majority
• Second House investigates the charges
• If approved, the President is removed
The President can be removed for violation of the Constitution.

items: Article 61 specifically lays down the procedure for the impeachment of the President.
Impeachment can originate in either the Lok Sabha or the Rajya Sabha.
The process strictly requires a special majority, not a simple majority.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The President can only be removed from office for violation of the Constitution.
The impeachment process can be initiated in either House of Parliament.
Passing the impeachment resolution requires a special majority.
The second House is responsible for investigating the charges brought against the President.
